content.short: A collection of 3,333 Pets and Bots NFTs, including both a PFP image and unique 3D art in one convenient package.
content.description:
The core collection, Petbots, consists of 3333 Bots and their Pets. With a large assortment of bots and accompanying pet traits, there is a wide variety of colorful combinations that burst with personality.

Through an interactive story driven experience, Petbots are the heroes of this narrative. Holders of Petbots will be able to participate in discord and web based events to progress through and explore the Petbot Universe. Through interactions with different aspects of the ecosystem, we are creating a system where Bots and Pets will grow alongside the project.
content.meta: Find out about Petbot on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions. Get immediate access to the project Website, Social Media, Whitepaper and Token distribution.
